mapper.select: SELECT FROM base_product p JOIN base_vendor v ON v.vendor_id = p.vendor_id WHERE p.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT IFNULL(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(product_code, 2) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) FROM base_product WHERE product_code REGEXP '^P[0-9]+$'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_product ( product_code, vendor_id, part_no, product_name, material, spec, charge_weight_kg, unit_weight_g, unit_price, price_unit, surface_hard_min, surface_hard_max, surface_hard_unit, core_hard_min, core_hard_max, core_hard_unit, remark, use_yn, reg_user_name ) VALUES ( #{productCode}, #{vendorId}, #{partNo}, #{productName}, #{material}, #{spec}, #{chargeWeightKg}, #{unitWeightG}, #{unitPrice}, #{priceUnit}, #{surfaceHardMin}, #{surfaceHardMax}, #{surfaceHardUnit}, #{coreHardMin}, #{coreHardMax}, #{coreHardUnit}, #{remark}, #{useYn}, #{regUserName} )
mapper.update: UPDATE base_product SET vendor_id = #{vendorId}, part_no = #{partNo}, product_name = #{productName}, material = #{material}, spec = #{spec}, charge_weight_kg = #{chargeWeightKg}, unit_weight_g = #{unitWeightG}, unit_price = #{unitPrice}, price_unit = #{priceUnit}, surface_hard_min = #{surfaceHardMin}, surface_hard_max = #{surfaceHardMax}, surface_hard_unit = #{surfaceHardUnit}, core_hard_min = #{coreHardMin}, core_hard_max = #{coreHardMax}, core_hard_unit = #{coreHardUnit}, remark = #{remark}, use_yn = #{useYn} WHERE product_id = #{productId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM base_product_image WHERE product_id IN #{id} ORDER BY product_id, slot
SELECT * FROM base_product_image WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND slot = #{slot}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO base_product_image (product_id, slot, orig_file_name, file_name, thumb_file_name, file_size) VALUES (#{productId}, #{slot}, #{origFileName}, #{fileName}, #{thumbFileName}, #{fileSize})
mapper.update: UPDATE base_product_image SET slot = #{slot} WHERE image_id = #{imageId}
